description: Sidebar brand de-duplication + lowercase wordmark (user_instruction change 4) AND corrected app icon everywhere (user_instruction change 5). Fix the sidebar so it shows a SINGLE lowercase 'athen' next to the icon, centered, with no duplicate 'Athen Athen'. Replace the app icon in every appearance (favicon file + inline Logo component) with a faithful corrected vector re-creation of the attached reference. HONESTY CONSTRAINT: the user's exact binary icon was NOT saved to disk and cannot be embedded; author a faithful hand-authored SVG and document in findings that it is a vector re-creation (the user can drop in their exact source to replace it for a pixel-exact match).
steps: Change 4 — sidebar brand: In src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx, the brand NavLink currently renders (which includes its own 'Athen' wordmark) AND Athen, producing 'Athen Athen'. Change it to render ONLY the logo mark plus a single lowercase wordmark: use (renders just the Logo, no wordmark) and change the span text to lowercase 'athen'. Do NOT alter BrandMark/Logo usage elsewhere (LandingPage, AuthCard, NotFoundPage keep 'Athen').

Change 4 — centering CSS: In src/styles/theme.css update .app-shell__brand (~line 112) to center the icon + wordmark horizontally (justify-content: center) while keeping the existing gap and padding. Keep .app-shell__brand-name styling (purple, bold) but ensure the single lowercase 'athen' reads cleanly; optionally add text-transform:lowercase to be safe. Verify in both light and dark themes (uses var(--brand-purple)).

Change 5 — corrected icon vector: Rewrite public/athen-logo.svg as a cleaner, better-proportioned mark matching the attached reference: a bold PURPLE crescent moon (var/brand purple #5B2A86) opening toward the lower-right; a large GOLD/YELLOW filled circle (#FFC107) nested in the opening with a THIN background-colored gap separating the crescent's inner edge from the gold circle so they read as distinct shapes; and a small DOWNWARD-POINTING purple triangle in the upper-right quadrant inside the gold circle. The crescent should be thick on the left and taper as it wraps. Keep viewBox 0 0 64 64, role=img, <title>Athen</title>, aria-label.

Change 5 — inline Logo: Update the inline SVG in src/components/brand/Logo.tsx to be VISUALLY IDENTICAL to the new public/athen-logo.svg (same paths/shapes/colors, same viewBox 0 0 64 64). KEEP the component API intact: size, title (default 'Athen'), className, and the decorative mode (title===''  -> aria-hidden, no <title>). Use the gap technique (either a thin background/white ring behind the gold circle, or by compositing the crescent as a purple disc minus an offset disc that also clears a ring around the gold circle) so the crescent and gold circle are visibly separated, matching the SVG file.

Verify index.html still references /athen-logo.svg (favicon) — no change needed there; the file content change propagates. Confirm BrandMark still renders Logo so the sidebar, landing hero, auth card all pick up the new mark.

Record in this feature's findings the exact honesty caveat text for the PR body: the icon is a hand-authored vector re-creation of the attached reference (not the user's exact binary, which was not available on disk), and the user can replace public/athen-logo.svg and the inline Logo paths with their exact source for a pixel-perfect match.
acceptance_criteria: The sidebar brand shows exactly ONE wordmark, lowercase 'athen', next to the icon, horizontally centered; no duplicate 'Athen Athen'.
Other BrandMark/Logo callers (LandingPage, AuthCard, NotFoundPage) are unchanged and still show 'Athen'.

public/athen-logo.svg and src/components/brand/Logo.tsx both render the corrected mark (purple tapering crescent + gold circle with a visible thin gap + small downward purple triangle) and are visually identical to each other.
Logo component API (size/title/className/decorative) is preserved; favicon via index.html picks up the new file.
findings contains the icon honesty caveat for the PR body. No new eslint/TS warnings; build is clean.
verification: npm run lint reports no new warnings
npm run build exits 0 and emits the updated favicon
grep confirms AppShell renders a single lowercase 'athen' span and BrandMark hideWordmark
findings: Change 4 (sidebar brand): AppShell now renders <BrandMark size={30} hideWordmark /> (logo mark only) plus a single lowercase 'athen' span; .app-shell__brand gained justify-content:center and .app-shell__brand-name gained text-transform:lowercase. Other callers (LandingPage header BrandMark size=36, hero Logo size=96; AuthCard; NotFoundPage) were left untouched and still show 'Athen'. Change 5 (icon): public/athen-logo.svg and src/components/brand/Logo.tsx were rewritten to a cleaner mark (purple crescent via evenodd outer-minus-offset disc opening toward lower-right, a thin #ffffff gap ring, a gold #FFC107 circle nested in the opening, and a small downward-pointing purple triangle). Both are visually identical (same paths/colors/viewBox 0 0 64 64). Logo component API preserved (size default 32, title default 'Athen', className, decorative mode when title==='' -> aria-hidden, no <title>, role undefined). index.html favicon reference /athen-logo.svg unchanged; build emits dist/athen-logo.svg. Verification: npm run typecheck (0 errors), npm run lint (5 pre-existing warnings only, no new ones), npm run test (208 passed), npm run build (clean). ICON HONESTY CAVEAT FOR PR BODY: The app icon is a hand-authored vector re-creation of the attached reference image, not the user's exact binary asset. That raw binary was not saved to the workspace/disk and could not be embedded, so the mark was reproduced faithfully by hand in SVG. For a pixel-exact match, the user can drop their exact source into public/athen-logo.svg and mirror the same paths into the inline SVG in src/components/brand/Logo.tsx. Visual aspects (exact crescent taper, gap thickness, triangle placement, light/dark theme appearance) are only fully verifiable in a browser.
